chunks.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves relevant document chunks before asking a language model to generate an answer.
In a RAG system, retrieved context is provided to the language model so that the generated answer is grounded in external knowledge.
Embeddings are dense numerical vector representations that capture semantic information about text.
Cosine similarity measures how similar two vectors are by comparing the angle between them.
PostgreSQL is a relational database management system used to persist structured application data.
pgvector is a PostgreSQL extension that adds vector data types and vector similarity search.
Docker packages applications and their dependencies into isolated containers.
Docker Compose defines and runs multiple containerized services using a YAML configuration file.
